title: Intuition is the Voice of the Non-Physical World
fullTitle: Soul Snack #4: Intuition is the Voice of the Non-Physical World
description: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav explores the power of intuition and its vital role in our spiritual growth .

Gary guides us on how to cultivate and trust our intuition, using it not only for practical reasons like safety and decision-making but also as a powerful tool for creativity, personal transformation, and deeper spiritual understanding.
Gary also shares that developing intuition requires an open, curious approach to life, emotional and nutritional cleanliness, and a willingness to experiment with what you receive.
This soul snack encourages listeners to explore how they experience intuition and provides practical steps to deepen their connection to it.
